kicker: AuK, counted from its own checkpoint

scenes.headline: How AuK generates and edits speech from instructions
scenes.sub: A frozen LLM for meaning, a shared VAE, and a diffusion transformer.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Blondie! AuK is an open speech foundation model: speech generation, editing and cleanup, all from plain-language instructions. Here's how.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: A frozen multimodal model reads the instruction, and one diffusion transformer denoises audio in a single shared latent space, whatever the task.
scenes.say: Every task is the same move. A frozen multimodal model reads the instruction, and a diffusion transformer denoises audio in one shared latent space.

steps.say: An instruction and any reference audio go into a frozen multimodal Qwen model.

steps.note: learned softmax weights over layers, times one scale
steps.say: AuK ignores its text output. It takes every layer's hidden state and blends them with learned weights.
That blend steers a diffusion transformer, which denoises sixty-four-dimensional audio latents, fifty per second.
A VAE, trained on speech, sound and music, decodes the result to a twenty-four kilohertz waveform.

scenes.title: Why ten blocks, then twenty
scenes.say: Ten dual-stream blocks come first, then twenty single-stream ones. The split isn't arbitrary.

parts.note: dual-stream: separate norms and FFNs per stream, one joint attention
parts.say: Early on, text and audio keep their own norms and feed-forwards, but share one joint attention.

parts.note: single-stream: one sequence, shared weights, exactly half the size
parts.say: Then one shared stream is cheaper: each block is exactly half the size, so both halves spend the same budget.

scenes.title: The full model, and the distilled Flash

left.title: AuK: 32 steps, CFG 2.0
left.say: The full model takes thirty-two steps with guidance, and guidance doubles each step's batch: sixty-four units.

right.title: AuK-Flash: 4 steps, no CFG
items: 4 units of step cost, a 16x ratio
Reasoned: encoder and VAE costs stay fixed
right.say: Flash takes four steps without guidance: sixteen times less step work, but four point five times faster, as reported. Fixed costs, reasoned, eat the rest.

scenes.label: parameters in the backbone, read from the checkpoint's own header
scenes.note: all 420 tensors F32; bf16 is chosen at compute time
scenes.say: Read from the checkpoint's own header: one point five three billion backbone parameters, all stored in full thirty-two-bit precision.

scenes.text: A shared latent space and a multimodal encoder let one model generate, edit and clean speech without swapping representations.

recap: A frozen LLM's layers, blended, condition the denoiser
Ten dual-stream, then twenty single-stream blocks
scenes.say: To recap: a blended language model conditions a split transformer over shared audio latents, and Flash trades steps for speed.
